product_findings.trigger: A selected numeric value or selected column name begins with =, for example =1+1.
product_findings.observed_source_behavior: Explicit string typing is used only for the raw sheet. Summary and anomaly rows use append directly, so openpyxl serializes formula-looking names or invalid values as formula cells.
product_findings.public_contract: lab-prompt.md:21-22 requires selected column names and original anomaly values, not evaluated formulas.
